description: The bar chart illustrates the average Joint Goal Accuracy (JGA) score at each turn for two models—LLaMA-7B (represented by orange bars) and T5-small (represented by yellow bars)—across a sequence of turns labeled from 0 to 26 on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. JGA Score,” ranges from 0.2 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, indicating the performance metric for dialogue state tracking. For most turn IDs, LLaMA-7B consistently achieves a higher JGA score than T5-small, with both models showing a general downward trend in performance as the turn ID increases. Notably, at Turn 0, both models start near peak performance (approximately 0.95 for LLaMA-7B and 0.94 for T5-small), but by Turn 26, LLaMA-7B scores around 0.45 while T5-small drops to approximately 0.33. The bars are grouped by turn ID, with LLaMA-7B always positioned to the left of T5-small within each group, and the legend in the top-right corner clearly identifies the color coding for each model. The chart visually emphasizes the relative stability and superior performance of LLaMA-7B over T5-small across the dialogue turns.
